args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production following its deploy. trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified afterward: all regions healthy, error rate ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions"), which has paged the on-call engineer.

No approval was needed since the rollback targeted v2.3.0, a version that had already been healthy in production. Recommend root-causing v2.3.1's health check failures before attempting any re-deploy.
